rules.title: Administrators authenticate against a central AAA server
Local passwords are stored with a strong one-way hash
Repeated failed logins are blocked
No password is stored in the configuration in clear text
Passwords must be at least 15 characters
No filter entry permits all traffic from anywhere to anywhere
Untrusted interfaces filter inbound traffic
Configuration changes are logged
Logs are sent to a remote log server
Log messages carry the date and time
A login banner warns against unauthorised use
Unencrypted HTTP management is disabled
Idle management sessions time out within 10 minutes
SSH management uses protocol version 2 only
Clear-text Telnet management is not reachable
Remote management lines accept only permitted sources
The ACL guarding remote management exists and doesn't permit everyone
Web management accepts only permitted sources
Every reference points at something that exists
No SNMP community is well known or writable
Legacy network services are disabled
Interfaces do not answer ARP for other hosts
Time sources are authenticated

controls.title: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
Store on Separate Physical Systems or Components
Deny by Default — Allow by Exception
